purpose: Owned typed issuance proving and complete owned GPU selection through maintained candidate wallet request/research APIs
result: Forty-two new candidate leaf proofs CPU-verified after GPU shutdown, including eighteen issuance proofs; all previous join-split, HTLC and recursive regressions pass

candidate_entrypoints.selection: The complete explicitly initialized owned OpenCL selection routes compatible and GPU-required requests to the owned prover. Other selections retain existing policy admission; strict requests cannot fall back to CPU.
candidate_entrypoints.lifecycle: GPU selection remains configured after engine shutdown. A resident-engine check rejects later requests before the infallible configuration constructor, for both GPU-required and compatible policy, without reinitialization or CPU fallback.
candidate_entrypoints.authorization: The host independently authorizes nonzero in-range mint and issuance count. The request checks the witness amount before private work and rechecks the GPU-produced public mint before proving. No authority is granted by the proof API.
admission_controls: issuance attempted through spend or HTLC route
retired backend under strict or compatible policy
candidate_entrypoints.debug_cpu_audit: Explicit constraint audit remains; trace reads are 622592 bytes for join-split/issuance and 1179648 bytes for HTLC per proof

pilot_notes: Pilot 01 passed issuance trace conformance and produced all seven candidate proofs, then failed a fixture assertion that shutdown clears backend selection. The failed run is preserved and is not counted as CPU-verified.

The lifecycle check revealed that selected-but-retired GPU entrypoints needed a live resident-engine guard before configuration construction. The implementation now returns GpuFailure without CPU fallback, and pilot 02 validates this behavior and CPU-verifies all seven proofs after shutdown.
validator_notes: Two wide-release records initially stored the issuance proof count as the Rust case count because a validator loop variable shadowed the parsed test count. The original manifest/runner are preserved; metadata was corrected against unchanged hashed Rust logs. The final evidence audit independently reparses every test result.
limitations: NVIDIA OpenCL correctness and coverage qualification only; no production transactions/hour or resource calibration
Debug retains explicit CPU constraint auditing and rejects GPU-required requests
External mint authorization/issuance count, HTLC preimage acceptance and independently expected height remain host responsibilities
Legacy quadratic wallet/batch and C ABI integration, private wallet worker admission, owned multi-AIR commitments and full-size recursive workloads remain open
AMD and Metal are unqualified; pending Mac source still requires the authorized local checkpoint commit
